definitions.gloss: camping overnight in a tent (vs. a mountain hut)
definitions.explanation: Spending the night in a tent while hiking or trekking, as opposed to staying at a mountain hut. Common among serious hikers who carry full camping gear, including a tent, sleeping bag, and cookware.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧テント{泊|はく}です。
examples.english: This time we're camping in tents.

examples.japanese: テント{泊|はく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{装備|そうび}→装備：14103_soubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧。

⟦{山小屋|やまごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧{泊|はく}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧テント{泊|はく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Tent camping lets you move around more freely than staying at mountain huts.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- テント{泊|はく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to camp overnight in a tent
- テント{泊|はく}⟦{装備|そうび}→装備：14103_soubi⟧: full camping gear
- テント{泊|はく}{縦走|じゅうそう}: a multi-day trek with tent camping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{山小屋|やまごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧{泊|はく}: staying at a mountain hut — no need to carry a tent, sleeping bag, or cooking gear
- ⟦{日帰|ひがえ}り→日帰り：17612_higaeri⟧: day trip — no overnight stay at all
